vcu_g_148_2000144f.name: display_148_level
vcu_g_148_2000144f.description: Displayed level (0..100 %) of the VCU_148 level gauge. vcu_level_gauge_update_v148 moves it toward the requested level in steps of +5 when the flag bit DAT_20001a20 bit 2 is set (a step that overshoots 109 or goes below the target is replaced by the target); otherwise it jumps to the target. Passed to FUN_0800b0f4 to draw the bar and digits.

vcu_g_148_20001450.name: display_148_tick
vcu_g_148_20001450.description: Tick counter of the VCU_148 level gauge: incremented on every call of vcu_level_gauge_update_v148 and reset to 0 when it reaches the step interval display_148_interval (0x20001482). The gauge only steps when the counter has reached that interval.

vcu_g_148_20001451.name: display_148_status_idx
vcu_g_148_20001451.description: Index into the 2-byte-stride status table at base+0x12 of the struct returned by the status helper (wrap count at base+0x0e). Used on the idle branch when group B of the status flags (display_148_flags bit 5) is active; advances every 300 ticks (display_148_status_period) and wraps at the count. Probably a cycling status indicator.

vcu_g_148_20001452.name: display_148_bar_idx
vcu_g_148_20001452.description: Index into the 2-byte-stride table at base+0x72 (wrap count at base+0x10) used when group A of the status flags (display_148_flags bit 0) is active. Advances every 300 ticks (display_148_bar_period) and wraps at the count; probably selects the bar/segment step shown while group A is active.

vcu_g_148_20001482.name: display_148_interval
vcu_g_148_20001482.description: Step interval of the VCU_148 level gauge in gauge ticks, computed as FUN_0800e02c(level, 0, 100, 10) from the requested level (0..100 %), so it spans a 0..10 range. display_148_tick is compared with it on every update.

vcu_g_148_20001484.name: display_148_status_period
vcu_g_148_20001484.description: 300-tick period counter of the VCU_148 status cycling (display_148_status_idx). Incremented on each status-path update, the index advances when it exceeds 300, and the counter is then reset to 0.

vcu_g_148_20001486.name: display_148_bar_period
vcu_g_148_20001486.description: 300-tick period counter of the VCU_148 bar cycling (display_148_bar_idx), same behaviour as display_148_status_period but used on the group-A path.

vcu_g_148_20001488.name: display_148_flags
vcu_g_148_20001488.description: Status flag word of the VCU_148 gauge. Bit 0 is set while any of the counters at 0x20001c0c, 0x20001c0e, 0x20001c10, 0x20001c12 is non-zero (group A active); bit 5 is set while any of 0x20001c14, 0x20001c16, 0x20001c18 is non-zero (group B active). Selects the cycling path and is passed to FUN_0800b990 as the LED group bits.

vcu_g_148_20001494.name: display_digit_glyphs_148
vcu_g_148_20001494.description: Digit glyph tables of the VCU_148 build: seg_a at 0x20001494, seg_b at +0x0a and seg_c at +0x14, ten entries each, indexed by the decimal digit 0..9. FUN_0800b84c (VCU_148 units writer) copies them to LED frame bytes 0x200021d2 (seg_a), 0x200021d3 (low nibble, seg_b) and 0x200021d4 (seg_c). Not written by the code in this packet, so probably constant data or set once at boot.

vcu_g_153_200014ef.name: display_153_blink30
vcu_g_153_200014ef.description: VCU_153 build: 30-tick period counter (wraps at 0x1e) of the VCU_153 display renderer FUN_08005648. Each wrap advances the blink/pulse sub-phases; the same role as display_state1_phase30 (0x200014fb) in VCU_0159.

vcu_g_0159_200014f0.name: display_sweep_period
vcu_g_0159_200014f0.description: Period (ticks per step) of the downward segment sweep: vcu_display_sweep_down_step steps when its counter display_sweep_div (0x200021e2) is a multiple of this value. Its address is taken by lighting_brightness_percent_set, which probably sets it; it is not written in the functions of this packet.

vcu_g_153_200014f0.name: display_153_seq_idx_a
vcu_g_153_200014f0.description: VCU_153 build: index into the segment-sequence table at 0x200021d8 (VCU_153 layout), read as (&table)[index] by FUN_08005648 and bounded by the count at 0x200021d4. Advances on the 153 renderer's period and wraps at the count; the 153 counterpart of display_seq_idx.

vcu_g_0159_200014f1.name: display_sweep_mirror
vcu_g_0159_200014f1.description: Offset of the mirrored segment in the downward sweep: vcu_display_sweep_down_step lights segment (display_sweep_pos - offset) in the second segment group. Read only in this packet; probably a fixed sweep width set elsewhere.

vcu_g_153_200014f1.name: display_153_seq_idx_b
vcu_g_153_200014f1.description: VCU_153 build: index into the table at 0x20002238 (the VCU_153 warning list, 16 bytes below the VCU_0159 position 0x20002248), read as (&table)[index] and bounded by the count at 0x200021d6. Advances on the 153 renderer's period; the 153 counterpart of display_warn_idx.

vcu_g_0159_200014f2.name: display_sweep_up_period
vcu_g_0159_200014f2.description: Divider (ticks per step) of the upward segment sweep in vcu_display_anim_step (sub-mode 12): the sweep steps when display_anim_step (0x200021de) is a multiple of this value. Not written in this packet.

vcu_g_153_200014f2.name: display_153_pulse_phase
vcu_g_153_200014f2.description: VCU_153 build: 0..3 sub-phase counter of the alert pulse in the 153 renderer; it counts up and saturates at 3 once it reaches 2, like display_state3_phase (0x200014fe) in VCU_0159.

vcu_g_0159_200014f3.name: display_sweep_band
vcu_g_0159_200014f3.description: Width (in segments) of the moving band of the upward sweep (vcu_display_anim_step sub-mode 12). Positions below the width light a segment; positions up to twice the width move the band by lighting one segment and clearing the one behind it; then the sweep restarts. Not written in this packet.

vcu_g_153_200014f3.name: display_153_pulse_flag
vcu_g_153_200014f3.description: VCU_153 build: 0..1 wrap counter of the alert pulse in the 153 renderer (resets to 0 after 1), the counterpart of display_pulse_count (0x200014ff) in VCU_0159.

vcu_g_153_200014f6.name: display_153_level
vcu_g_153_200014f6.description: Displayed level (0..100 %) of the VCU_14A..VCU_153 level gauge (vcu_level_gauge_update_v14a_153). Moved +5 toward the requested level on each update and passed to FUN_0800bf18 to draw the bar and digits.

vcu_g_153_200014f7.name: display_153_tick
vcu_g_153_200014f7.description: Tick counter of the VCU_14A..VCU_153 level gauge: incremented on each update of vcu_level_gauge_update_v14a_153 and reset to 0 when it reaches the step interval display_153_gauge_interval (0x2000152a).

vcu_g_0159_200014f9.name: display_state6_blink
vcu_g_0159_200014f9.description: 40-tick blink counter of display state 6 in vcu_display_frame_render_tick: incremented on every tick, the segments are on while it is below 20, off from 20 to 39, and it wraps to 0 at 40.

vcu_g_0159_200014fa.name: display_state0b_warn_idx
vcu_g_0159_200014fa.description: Index into the active warning list (0x20002248) shown by display state 0x0B. It advances about every 300 ticks (display_state0b_timer, 0x20001516) and wraps when it reaches the warning count 0x200021e6.

vcu_g_0159_200014fb.name: display_state3_phase30
vcu_g_0159_200014fb.description: 30-tick phase counter of display state 3 in vcu_display_frame_render_tick. It wraps at 0x1e; at each wrap, while display_alert_request (0x20001f65) is set the alert pulse counter display_pulse_count advances, otherwise the pulse state is reset and the state-3 digit is redrawn.

vcu_g_0159_200014fc.name: display_seq_idx
vcu_g_0159_200014fc.description: Index into the 96-byte sequence table at 0x200021e8 (count in 0x200021e4), used by display state 3 to pick the next segment group to show. Advanced by the period counter display_state3_seq_period (0x2000151a) and reset to 0 when it reaches the count.

vcu_g_0159_200014fd.name: display_warn_idx
vcu_g_0159_200014fd.description: Index into the active warning list (0x20002248) shown by display state 3 when a warning is active. Advanced by the period counter display_state3_warn_period (0x2000151c) and wrapped at the warning count 0x200021e6.

vcu_g_0159_200014fe.name: display_state3_phase
vcu_g_0159_200014fe.description: 0..3 pulse sub-phase counter of the alert pulse in display state 3 (counts up and saturates at 3 once it reaches 2). Steps 0 and 1 drive the first flash and 2 and 3 the second.

vcu_g_0159_200014ff.name: display_pulse_count
vcu_g_0159_200014ff.description: 0..1 counter of the two-step alert pulse requested by display_alert_request (0x20001f65): it advances on each 30-tick wrap of display_state3_phase30; after the second step the request is cleared and FUN_08001b64(4) is called (probably an indicator or beep). Advanced by display_state3_phase30 (state 3 of the renderer).

vcu_g_0159_20001500.name: display_state8_seq_idx
vcu_g_0159_20001500.description: Index into the sequence table at 0x200021e8 (count 0x200021e4) used by display state 0x08 in its non-countdown branch. Advanced every 300 ticks by display_state8_seq_timer (0x20001524) and wrapped at the count.

vcu_g_0159_20001501.name: display_state8_warn_idx
vcu_g_0159_20001501.description: Index into the active warning list (0x20002248) shown by display state 0x08 when a warning is active. Advanced every 300 ticks by display_state8_warn_timer (0x20001526) and wrapped at the warning count 0x200021e6.

vcu_g_0159_20001502.name: display_gauge_level
vcu_g_0159_20001502.description: Displayed level (0..100 %) of the VCU_0159 level gauge (vcu_level_gauge_update_v0159). Moves toward the requested level in steps of +5 when the flag bit DAT_20001aec bit 2 is set (overshoot is replaced by the target); passed to FUN_0800bf84.

vcu_g_0159_20001503.name: display_gauge_warn_idx
vcu_g_0159_20001503.description: Index into the active warning list (0x20002248) cycled by the VCU_0159 level gauge while a warning is active. Advanced every 300 ticks by display_gauge_warn_timer (0x2000153a) and wrapped at the warning count 0x200021e6.

vcu_g_0159_20001504.name: display_gauge_tick
vcu_g_0159_20001504.description: Tick counter of the VCU_0159 level gauge: incremented on each update and reset when it reaches display_gauge_interval (0x20001538), after which the gauge steps.

vcu_g_0159_20001508.name: display_last_state
vcu_g_0159_20001508.description: Copy of the display state DAT_2000123e from the previous renderer tick. When the state changes the renderer clears the LED frame image and restarts the state's sequences.

vcu_g_0159_2000150a.name: display_sweep_pos
vcu_g_0159_2000150a.description: Position of the downward segment sweep, starting at 20 and counting down to 0 in vcu_display_sweep_down_step. Each step lights the mirrored segment at (position - display_sweep_mirror) and clears the segment at the position; when it reaches 0 the sweep starts again at 20.

vcu_g_0159_2000150c.name: display_anim_submode
vcu_g_0159_2000150c.description: Sub-mode of vcu_display_anim_step, set from the caller's argument when the step counter display_anim_step is 0. Values: 0 and 9 = icons on, 10 = icon blink (off at step 50, reset at 100), 11 = idle, 12 = upward segment sweep, 13 = icons on.

vcu_g_153_2000150c.name: display_153_seq_period
vcu_g_153_2000150c.description: VCU_153 build: period counter for the 0x200021d8 sequence table, wrapping at the count held at 0x200021d4 (counterpart of display_state3_seq_period in VCU_0159).

vcu_g_0159_2000150e.name: display_anim_band_pos
vcu_g_0159_2000150e.description: Position of the moving band in the upward sweep (vcu_display_anim_step sub-mode 12). Runs from 0 to twice display_sweep_band, then restarts at 0.

vcu_g_153_2000150e.name: display_153_warn_period
vcu_g_153_2000150e.description: VCU_153 build: period counter for the VCU_153 warning-list index display_153_seq_idx_b, wrapping at the count from 0x200021d6 (counterpart of display_state3_warn_period in VCU_0159).

vcu_g_153_20001510.name: display_153_countdown_ticks
vcu_g_153_20001510.description: VCU_153 build: countdown tick counter of the start countdown (0..400 ticks). The digit 3, 2, 1, 0 is chosen at 100, 200, 300 and 400 ticks and the handshake is marked complete at the end (counterpart of display_state3_countdown).

vcu_g_153_20001512.name: display_153_countdown_digit
vcu_g_153_20001512.description: VCU_153 build: countdown digit shown during the start countdown (3, 2, 1, then 0), drawn with FUN_0800c6b4 (counterpart of display_state3_digit in VCU_0159).

vcu_g_153_20001514.name: display_153_flags
vcu_g_153_20001514.description: VCU_153 build: packed display flag word. Each tick it is assembled from the input-hold bit (display_input_b_hold, bit 3), the drive sub-mode bit (vehicle_submode_flag, bit 6), the warning and speed-state bits and bit 1 from DAT_20001d04, then it drives the segment helper calls (same role as display_state3_flags in VCU_0159).

vcu_g_0159_20001516.name: display_state0b_timer
vcu_g_0159_20001516.description: 300-tick timer of display state 0x0B: incremented each tick, and each time it exceeds 300 the warning index display_state0b_warn_idx advances.

vcu_g_0159_20001518.name: display_state0b_flags
vcu_g_0159_20001518.description: Flag word of display state 0x0B: bit 0 is set while any of the four warning bitmap words 0x20001cd8, 0x20001cda, 0x20001cdc, 0x20001cde is non-zero, and this bit drives FUN_0800c81c.

vcu_g_0159_2000151a.name: display_state3_seq_period
vcu_g_0159_2000151a.description: Period counter of display state 3 for the sequence index display_seq_idx (0x200014fc). Counts ticks and advances the index when it passes the threshold returned by the helper call.

vcu_g_0159_2000151c.name: display_state3_warn_period
vcu_g_0159_2000151c.description: Period counter of display state 3 for the warning index display_warn_idx (0x200014fd); same behaviour as display_state3_seq_period, with the threshold returned by a different helper.

vcu_g_0159_2000151e.name: display_state3_countdown
vcu_g_0159_2000151e.description: Countdown tick counter of display state 3 (the start countdown shown while display_countdown_state is non-zero). It runs 0..400: the digit changes at 100, 200, 300 and 400 ticks; at 300 the 0x7A message is sent to peer 7 via FUN_0800d018; at 400 display_countdown_state is set to 2.

vcu_g_0159_20001520.name: display_state3_digit
vcu_g_0159_20001520.description: Countdown digit shown in display state 3 during the start countdown: 3 until 100 ticks, then 2, 1 and 0 (drawn by FUN_0800c720).

vcu_g_0159_20001522.name: display_state3_flags
vcu_g_0159_20001522.description: Packed display flag word of display state 3, assembled each tick from the input-hold bit (display_input_b_hold, bit 3), the drive sub-mode bit (vehicle_submode_flag, bit 6), status bits 0x20001cf6, 0x20001d06, 0x20001cd8..0x20001cde and 0x20001ce0..0x20001ce4, and bit 1 from 0x20001d14. The bit fields are split by the segment helpers (FUN_0800c698, FUN_0800c78c, FUN_0800c660, FUN_0800c7c8, FUN_0800bf04 and others).

vcu_g_153_20001522.name: display_153_blink_ticks
vcu_g_153_20001522.description: VCU_153 build: 150-tick sequence counter for the indicator/blink sequence gated by display_indicator_gate (0x20001fb2). Each 30-tick step toggles one blink phase (thresholds 0x1e, 0x3c, 0x5a, 0x78, 0x96), and the sequence ends and clears the gate at 0x96. Counterpart of display_state2_blink_ticks in VCU_0159.

vcu_g_0159_20001524.name: display_state8_seq_timer
vcu_g_0159_20001524.description: 300-tick timer of display state 0x08 for the sequence index display_state8_seq_idx: each time it exceeds 300 the index advances and the timer restarts at 0.

vcu_g_0159_20001526.name: display_state8_warn_timer
vcu_g_0159_20001526.description: 300-tick timer of display state 0x08 for the warning index display_state8_warn_idx (same behaviour as display_state8_seq_timer, used only while a warning is active).

vcu_g_0159_20001528.name: display_state8_countdown
vcu_g_0159_20001528.description: Countdown tick counter of display state 0x08 (start countdown), counting 0..400: the digit changes at 100, 200, 300 and 400 ticks and display_countdown_state is set to 2 at the end. Counterpart of display_state3_countdown.

vcu_g_0159_2000152a.name: display_state8_digit
vcu_g_0159_2000152a.description: Countdown digit shown in display state 0x08 during the start countdown (3, 2, 1, 0).

vcu_g_153_2000152a.name: display_153_gauge_interval
vcu_g_153_2000152a.description: Step interval of the VCU_14A..VCU_153 level gauge in gauge ticks, computed as FUN_0800eee0(level, 0, 100, 10) (same role as display_gauge_interval in VCU_0159). vcu_level_gauge_update_v14a_153 steps the gauge when display_153_tick reaches it.

vcu_g_0159_2000152c.name: display_state8_flags
vcu_g_0159_2000152c.description: Packed display flag word of display state 0x08, built like display_state3_flags (bit 3 from display_input_b_hold, bit 6 from vehicle_submode_flag, plus the status bits), and split by the segment helpers FUN_0800c7b8, FUN_0800c800, FUN_0800c7e4, FUN_0800c660, FUN_0800c7c8.

vcu_g_0159_2000152e.name: display_state2_change_ticks
vcu_g_0159_2000152e.description: Tick counter of the state-2 change animation. It is restarted to 0 when the digit value 0x2000202d changes, then counts 0..19 with the segment helper FUN_0800c57c and 20..29 with FUN_0800c720(0).

vcu_g_0159_20001530.name: display_state2_blink_ticks
vcu_g_0159_20001530.description: Second tick counter of the state-2 blink while display_blink_active (0x20001fc4) is set: 0..29 segments on, 30..59 off, 60..89 on, 90..119 off, and at 120..149 the counter is reset to 0 and the flag cleared (the sequence ends). Probably the alarm pattern of the state-2 display.

vcu_g_0159_20001532.name: display_state9_ticks
vcu_g_0159_20001532.description: Tick counter of display state 0x09 for the change animation after the value 0x2000202d changes: 0..19 uses FUN_0800c57c, 20..29 uses FUN_0800c720(0) (same pattern as display_state2_change_ticks).

vcu_g_0159_20001534.name: display_state2_flash_ticks
vcu_g_0159_20001534.description: First tick counter of the state-2 blink while display_blink_active is set: 0..19 on (FUN_0800c81c(1) and FUN_08001b64(3)), 20..39 off, and at 40 it resets to 0 and clears display_blink_active (the sequence ends).

vcu_g_0159_20001536.name: display_state2_period
vcu_g_0159_20001536.description: Period counter of the state-2 display, wrapping at 0x50 (80). At multiples of 40 the segment bits of the state-2 digit are refreshed from the stored value and at multiples of 80 the digit-select bits are cleared.
